programs.title: The Mighty Quinn
programs.desc: When police officer Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) learns that his childhood friend has become the prime suspect in a murder case, he also discovers that he's the only one who feels that his friend was framed to protect the local tourism business.

programs.title: Blind Rage
programs.desc: They don't need to see to steal!  They're five unstoppable blind men. They can hear your heartbeat, smell your fear, and almost taste $15 million in secret CIA loot.  Only one man stands in their way.  He's the ultimate mercenary, and he doesn't know when to quit.  They may be close to the perfect crime, but they'll never know what hit them.

programs.title: Hell Up In Harlem
programs.desc: Recovering from an onslaught of bullets that would have killed a lesser man, the Godfather of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs, is back and is out for revenge against the sleazy New York District Attorney (Gerald Gordon) who had set up the hit-gone-wrong.

programs.title: Kinjite: Forbidden Subjects
programs.desc: Action superstar Charles Bronson is at his two-fisted best in this gritty thriller about a hardnosed vice cop who is hellbent on wiping out a child prostitution ring after an assault on his young daughter; taking vengeance into his own hands!

programs.title: Murphy's Law
programs.desc: Charles Bronson stars as an LAPD cop framed for murder by Joan Freeman, a vicious ex-con he had put in prison. Going on the run and handcuffed to a foul-mouthed petty thief, he attempts to track down Freeman even as she keeps killing his associates.

programs.title: Remo Williams: The Adventure Begins
programs.desc: Brace yourself for an hilarious, action-packed adventure! When an NYPD cop (Fred Ward) regains consciousness after a mugging, he has a new identity! He's Remo Williams, a recruit of a top-secret organization, and he's toppling evil at every turn!
